label: sound
evidence: Assumes a regular decagon and computes all 15 slopes (all correct: 5-8, 10-3, 9-4 = -tan72; 10-8, 7-1, 5-3 = tan18; 3-8 = tan72; 4-2, 7-9 = -tan18; 2-7 = tan36; 10-4 = -tan54; 7-3, 1-9 = tan54; 10-7, 6-1 horizontal). Proves exact perpendicularity from tan72*tan18 = 1 and tan36*tan54 = 1. Checks every group's partner (tan54 needs -tan36, absent; horizontals need a vertical, absent), giving 9+2+1. Verifies each pair: 4 meet at shared vertices (dot product 0) and 8 cross at points inside the circle, which puts them on both chords. My computation gives exactly these 12 pairs, with matching points. A side check mislabels 'diag4 and diag13 ... 90°' at vertex 3; that pair is not counted.
